name: La Samanna
positioning: La Samanna, A Belmond Hotel, a beach resort on Baie Longue in St Martin with a history dating to 1974
best_for: Travelers who want a beach stay with free watersports
Guests who enjoy Italian and French dining and private wine cellar dinners

facts.text: The hotel lists a 15 minute drive from Princess Juliana International Airport.
The hotel lists a 20 minute ferry from Blowing Point, Anguilla.
The hotel was named for the original owners' daughters Samantha, Anouk and Nathalie.
La Samanna has drawn guests from the Kennedys to David Bowie since 1974.
Belmond took ownership of the hotel in 1996.
In the evening Laplaj turns into La Spiaggia, a trattoria-style Italian dinner spot.
Private dinners can be booked in Le Cave, described as the oldest wine cellar in the region.
A complimentary breakfast is served each morning at Corail.
The Watersports Center offers complimentary kayaks, Hobie Cat sailboats, paddleboards and snorkeling gear.
The three grass tennis courts have stadium-style lighting for play after dark.
Daily complimentary wellness classes are offered, from Pilates to chakra-healing meditation.
Several rooms come with personal plunge pools, while others open directly onto the sand.

considerations.text: Motorized watersports such as a WaveRunner cost an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the location is remote, so exploring the island requires transportation.
